messages:
Asha (Sales): Raj at Everlane asked if we can run a 10-day POC to prove compatibility with CloudPrompt without changing their frontend. Main asks: identical endpoint surface, token billing mapping, and a short security signoff. Can SE lead the compatibility shim?
Priya (SE): I'll take it. Quick checklist: endpoint paths, model name mapping, header semantics (user-id / org-id), streaming vs chunked responses, and tokenizer differences.
Carl (Solutions): POC scope suggestion: 1) proxy shim that rewrites /v1/generate -> /v1/chat; 2) run their 75 critical prompts + 20 templates; 3) record token counts and billing units; 4) smoke latency + failure recovery. Accept if functional drift <6% and no P0 regressions.
Ana (Security): They asked for DPA + SOC2 in the RFP. If they want VPC peering for Private, provisioning lead time ~12 business days. KMS is supported but will need key rotation plan. Also flagged a question about retention of user prompts in analytics.
Raj (Everlane): Pricing is sticky. CloudPrompt gave us a migration credit. Can Redwood match credits for first 2 months? Also we need clarity on whether per-request headers add extra fees from the shim.
Asha (Sales): We can offer a 2-month migration credit tied to committed usage. No extra shim fees from Redwood side. We'll document all units in the POC report.
Priya (SE): Proxy prototype snippet (staging):
```
POST /v1/generate -> /v1/chat/completions
map model: cp-large -> rdx-l2
preserve headers: X-User, X-Org
support streaming: true (fall back to chunked)
```
I'll include a tokenization parity script to match CloudPrompt's tokenizer.
Carl (Solutions): We'll build a harness to diff outputs: exact-match for structured fields, and Jaccard + cosine sim for free text. Also include a "safety" check for any changed stop-token behavior.
Priya (SE): Note: CloudPrompt treats the stop sequence "+END+" as soft stop; our runtime enforces hard stop. We'll add a client-side shim to mimic soft termination if needed.
Ana (Security): For DPA/legal: I can attach a redline and ask LegalBot to pre-seed the standard addendum. Data residency question: Everlane requires EU-only processing for EU users — Private deployment option covers that.
DeployBot: staging deploy OK: cp-compat-proxy v0.2 -> staging (build 4789) :white_check_mark:
Priya (SE): Running the 75-critical prompt run now, will post CSV diffs in channel tomorrow AM. Also will capture p50/p95 latency.
Raj (Everlane): Also include a rollback plan and a short runbook for toggling back to CloudPrompt if any user-visible regression.
Asha (Sales): Rollback spec: DNS weight shift + feature flag toggle. We'll include signed SLAs for the POC and a rollback clause in the SOW.
Priya (SE): Rollback steps in the runbook: 1) flip LB weights to 0% -> CloudPrompt, 2) restore any probing tokens, 3) invalidate local cache. We can complete switch in ~10-20 minutes depending on DNS TTLs.
Asha (Sales): Next steps: Priya - prototype + token parity output (by EOD), Carl - POC harness + report template (by EOD), Ana - DPA redline + VPC lead time (tomorrow), Me - SOW + migration credit term.
Raj (Everlane): Timeline works. We'll review the first diffs and the security addendum. Thanks. :thumbsup:
note: Presales POC coordination thread for a customer migrating from CloudPrompt. Thread contains brief messages, a small code snippet block, and next steps in Slack style.
